claude.result:
Perfect! All requirements are met. Here's a summary of the changes I made to add weekly subscription support:

## Changes Made

### Core Cycle Logic (`src/cycles.js`)
- Added `CYCLE.WEEK = 'weekly'` to supported billing cycles
- Updated `monthlyCents()` to:
  - Calculate weekly plans as `price × 52 ÷ 12`, rounded to nearest cent
  - Round yearly plans to nearest cent instead of cutting off (€100.06/year now shows €8.34/month instead of €8.33)
- Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly plans by adding 7 days repeatedly from the `--since` date

### CLI (`bin/subtrack.js`)
- Added `week` and `weekly` to the `EVERY` mapping
- Updated `cycleFlag()` to accept week as a valid option
- Simplified the `total` command to use `monthlyCents()` for all cycle types

### Export (`src/export.js`)
- Replaced hardcoded monthly calculations with `monthlyCents()` function to handle all cycle types

### Renewals (`src/renewals.js`)
- Fixed sorting to sort by actual date instead of formatted label for correct chronological order

### Tests (`test/cli.test.js`)
- Updated test expectation for yearly plan rounding (€119.99/year = €10.00/month after rounding)

## Verification
✅ `npm test` - all 34 tests pass
✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` works and shows €259.57/month
✅ €12 weekly = €52.00/month
✅ Weekly plans charge every 7 days from `--since`
✅ `subtrack renewals` lists weekly plans correctly
✅ All monthly costs are rounded to nearest cent (€100.06/year = €8.34/month)
✅ `list`, `total`, and `export` all show weekly plans with monthly costs
